player.title: Player registration
player.description: WallX Play screens run the dedicated Android player app on the Android box connected to your LED controller.
player.step1: Install the WallX Play Player app on the Android box.
player.step2: Open the app. It shows a pairing code and QR code on the screen.
player.step3: Sign in to WallX Play, open Screens and choose Add screen, then enter the code.
player.step4: An organization admin authorizes the screen before content is delivered.

notFound.title: Page not found

notAuthorized.title: No access
notAuthorized.description: This area is only for WallX platform administrators.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.description: After verifying your email you can request an organization. WallX reviews every new organization before it goes live.

forgot.description: Enter your email and we will send you a reset link.

onboarding.title: Set up your organization
onboarding.description: Tell us about your business. A WallX administrator reviews each request, usually within one business day.
onboarding.gstinHint: Optional now; needed for GST invoices.
onboarding.notesHint: For example: locations, LED wall sizes or integrations you need.
onboarding.responseRequired: Add a short reply for the reviewer.
onboarding.pendingBody: Your request for {{org}} is waiting for WallX approval. You will be able to add screens and publish content once it is approved.
onboarding.approvedNoAccess: This organization is approved but not currently active. Contact WallX support if this is unexpected.
onboarding.hasActiveOrg: You already belong to an active organization.
onboarding.inviteHint: Joining an existing organization? Open the invitation link your administrator sent you.

invite.title: Join organization
invite.description: You are signed in as {{email}}. Accept the invitation to join the organization.

roles.ownerHint: Full control, including billing and other owners.
roles.adminHint: Manages team, screens, content and settings. Cannot change billing.
roles.approverHint: Creates content and approves others’ content before publishing.
roles.viewerHint: Read-only access to screens, content and reports.

team.someSitesHint: Sees and manages only these sites’ screens, sensors and alerts. Organization-wide settings (team, billing, integrations) are not available.
team.inviteLinkHint: Send this link to the person you invited. It works once, only for their email address, and expires in 7 days.
team.removeBody: {{email}} will lose access to this organization immediately.
team.emailNote: Invitation emails are sent automatically once the notification service is enabled; until then, share the link yourself.

sites.description: Locations where your screens are installed.

sites.emptyBody: Add a site for each location, such as a store, lobby or factory floor. Screens and sensors are assigned to sites.
sites.groupsNote: Screen groups arrive with screen pairing in phase 3.
sites.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted. Sites with screens cannot be deleted.

settings.readOnly: Only owners and admins can change these settings.

settings.requireApprovalHint: Editors’ publishes become requests that an Approver, Admin or Owner must approve.
settings.requireApprovalNotInPlan: Publish approvals are part of the Professional plan.

overview.description: Platform health and work waiting for you.
overview.comingBody: Screen health, storage usage and billing issues appear here as those modules are built.

approvals.description: Every new organization must be approved before it can pair screens or publish content.

confirmBody.approve: {{org}} becomes active with a 14-day free trial. Its users can then add sites, team members and screens.

confirmBody.request_info: {{org}} stays inactive until the requester answers. They see your message.

approvals.messageHint: Visible to the requester and recorded in the audit log.

orgs.suspendBody: Users lose the ability to make changes and publish. This is recorded in the audit log.
